source_refs.note: Topic printed 5.4.2.2 Interpreting Outputs (PDF 143, printed 140); the number 5.4.2.2 is repeated. A strong association does not by itself prove cause; this caution is general knowledge, not in the book.

blocks.text: Interpreting a model's output means understanding what its results tell us and drawing conclusions. If a regression shows that hours studied strongly affect exam scores, we can conclude that studying more hours should help students improve.
